scope.operation: 256-byte prepared encode execution and public one-shot encode
scope.counts: K10/R5..8, K11/R5, and K13..16/R5..8 excluding K16/R8

implementation.description: One packed-slab terminal validates aggregate ranges before dispatching either an exact first-T8-block plus systematic generator-tail-column circuit for K10/R5..8 and K11/R5, or the existing fused two-block T8 executor for the qualified K13..16 cells.
fallbacks_retained: the existing K9 and K16/R8 exact owners

campaign.statistics: Each round averages the two log baseline/candidate contrasts in balanced ABBA or BAAB order. Point estimates are geometric means and intervals are two-sided Student-t 95 percent intervals over nine independent rounds.

validation.clean_committed_release: 2/2 focused hook and production tests passed from the d84ce20 build under a 256 MiB address-space cap
validation.strict_gcc: 2/2 focused tests passed with high warnings promoted to errors
validation.asan_ubsan: 2/2 focused tests passed with leak detection and halt-on-error
validation.release_graph: All 135 codec and other graph entries passed in the full serial Release run; the sole stale provenance-checker failure was repaired in d84ce20 and its two-test rerun passed, covering all 136 entries with passing evidence.
validation.hook_matrix: An independent generator oracle checked every K10..16/R5..8 B256 shape. All 20 promoted shapes selected the terminal through ordinary, one-item batch, and unaligned APIs; K9/K16 exact owners, seven excluded K11/K12 cells, B255/B257, K/R boundaries, sparse/detached layouts, forced-transform routes, overlap errors, and atomicity controls passed.
validation.isa_scan: The frozen candidate contains zero ZMM, opmask, or zero-mask register signatures, and every timed Leopard2 invocation resolved AVX2.

disposition: Promote the packed two-block T=8 256-byte AVX2 terminal for the 20 qualified legacy-high GF8 shapes. Every target clears the 5 percent lower-confidence gate against both the prior Leopard2 route and exact Leopard main, while all measured boundary controls remain regression-free.
